name: Sargasso
source: A visual short story with interaction, Sargasso immerses you in a stranding afloat on the mysterious Sargasso Sea with three potentially dangerous characters onboard. There may or may not be a monster in the seaweed. Your only goal is to survive.
translation: 《马尾藻》是一部带有互动的视觉短篇故事，让你沉浸在神秘的马尾藻海中搁浅的情景中，船上有三个潜在的危险角色。海藻里可能有怪物，也可能没有。你唯一的目标就是生存。
